'''Philippe Bouchet''' ({{IPA|fr|filip buʃɛ}}; born 1953) is a French [[biologist]] whose primary scientific fields of study are [[malacology]] (the study of molluscs) and [[taxonomy (biology)|taxonomy]]. He works at the [[Muséum National d'Histoire Naturelle]] in [[Paris]]. He is also a [[Commissioner]] of the [[International Commission on Zoological Nomenclature]].

Bouchet published [[Taxonomy of the Gastropoda (Bouchet & Rocroi, 2005)|Taxonomy of the Gastropoda]] with the malacologist [[Jean-Pierre Rocroi]] in 2005, which laid out a new taxonomy of [[Gastropod]] molluscs.

He has named over 500 new taxa of mollusks, with numerous others being named in his honor.

==Professional achievements==
Bouchet is a senior [[professor]] at the Muséum National d'Histoire Naturelle in Paris and is head of the Malacology laboratory and the Taxonomy Collections Unit there.<ref name="panglao-hotspot.org">{{cite web|url=http://www.panglao-hotspot.org/Main/investigators.html|title=Pangalao Marine Biodiversity Project website|access-date=6 December 2010|archive-date=3 March 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170303090015/http://www.panglao-hotspot.org/Main/investigators.html|url-status=dead}}</ref> He is also one of the Commissioners of the International Commission on Zoological Nomenclature and has been a member of the ICZN since 1990.<ref name="nhm.ac.uk">{{cite web|url=http://www.nhm.ac.uk/hosted_sites/iczn/Commissioners_Bouchet.html |title=ICZN website |access-date=6 December 2010  |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110608201500/http://www.nhm.ac.uk/hosted_sites/iczn/Commissioners_Bouchet.html |archive-date=8 June 2011 }}</ref>

Philippe Bouchet is co-editor of several volumes in the Tropical Deep-Sea Benthos series.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Tropical Deep-Sea Benthos volume 22 - Scientific Publications of the Muséum national d'Histoire naturelle, Paris |url=https://sciencepress.mnhn.fr/en/collections/memoires-du-museum-national-d-histoire-naturelle/tropical-deep-sea-benthos-volume-22 |access-date=2023-03-31 |website=sciencepress.mnhn.fr}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Tropical Deep-Sea Benthos volume 29 - Scientific Publications of the Muséum national d'Histoire naturelle, Paris |url=https://sciencepress.mnhn.fr/en/collections/memoires-du-museum-national-d-histoire-naturelle/tropical-deep-sea-benthos-volume-29 |access-date=2023-03-31 |website=sciencepress.mnhn.fr}}</ref>

In 2005, Bouchet was the senior author (editor) (with [[Jean-Pierre Rocroi]]) of a taxonomy of the Gastropoda, published in a paper entitled "Classification and Nomenclator of Gastropod Families" published in the journal ''[[Malacologia]]''.<ref name="Bouchet">{{Bouchet 2005}}</ref>

Bouchet is the head of the 2004 Panglao Marine Biodiversity Project.<ref name="panglao-hotspot.org"/>

==Taxa named, and taxa named in his honor==
By the end of 2010, Bouchet had described (alone or together with others) more than 500 new species, mainly gastropods.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://iczn.org/content/professor-philippe-bouchet |title=ICZN Professor Philippe Bouchet |access-date=1 August 2012  |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120320025745/http://iczn.org/content/professor-philippe-bouchet |archive-date=20 March 2012 }}</ref><ref name="taxlist">{{cite web |url=https://www.marinespecies.org/aphia.php?p=taxlist |title=Taxon list |publisher=Marinespecies.org |access-date=1 August 2012 }}</ref> More than 70 new species have been named in his honor.<ref name="taxlist" /> Bouchet was honored with a new genus named after him by Houart & Héros in 2008:'' [[Bouchetia (gastropod)|Bouchetia]]''.<ref>{{cite journal |url=http://cat.inist.fr/?aModele=afficheN&cpsidt=21934509 |author=Houart Roland |author2=Heros Virginie |title=Muricidae (Mollusca: Gastropoda) from Fiji and Tonga, Mémoires du Muséum national d'histoire naturelle |journal=Résultats des Campagnes Musorstom |issn=1243-4442 |year=2008 |volume=196 |pages=437–480 |language=fr |access-date=9 November 2010 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160131072034/http://cat.inist.fr/?aModele=afficheN&cpsidt=21934509 |archive-date=31 January 2016  }}</ref> And in 2012, Bouchet was honored by having a monotypic family (and genus) of gastropods named after him: [[Bouchetispiridae]] (and ''[[Bouchetispira]]'') by Kantor, Strong & Puillandre.<ref>{{cite journal | author = Kantor Y.I., Strong E.E., Puillandre N. | year = 2012 | title = A new lineage of Conoidea (Gastropoda: Neogastropoda) revealed by morphological and molecular data | journal = Journal of Molluscan Studies | volume = 78 | issue = 3| pages = 246–255 | doi=10.1093/mollus/eys007| doi-access = free }}</ref>

==Awards==
In 2001 Bouchet was awarded the Marine Sciences Prize of the [[French Academy of Sciences]] for his work on the vertical migration of [[gastropod]] [[larva]]e.<ref name="nhm.ac.uk"/>
